decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive plays with low-cost creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes discard spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to clear their threats. Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide card advantage and board presence. Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief help disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide combat tricks and recursion. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker serves as a finisher to close out games quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent's life total early on, while also leveraging synergies with cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Feign Death to generate additional value. Removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt help clear the way for your creatures to continue attacking, while cards like Undying Evil and Undying Malice provide protection and recursion for your key threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to put pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and maintain tempo. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent quickly while also disrupting their game plan, using cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon can also disrupt opponent's mana base, giving the deck an edge in certain matchups.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure on the opponent while also using cards like Terminate and Thoughtseize to disrupt their game plan. The deck is also able to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Undying Malice. With a mix of aggro creatures and disruption, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful control elements such as Oblivion Stone, Karn Liberated, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional versatility and options. The deck also includes threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Kozilek, Butcher of Truth to close out games quickly once it has established control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional source of mana and provides flexibility in building the deck.

The deck focuses on casting spells with cascade mechanics to rapidly deploy threats on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Dead / Gone and Brazen Borrower for disruption and removal, providing a well-rounded strategy for both offense and defense.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played using various tutor effects. It aims to combo off using Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana, which can then be used to win the game with Walking Ballista or other key threats. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Kaldra Compleat and Luxior, Giada's Gift for additional value and versatility. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The goal is to use creative combos involving Teferi, Time Raveler, Transmogrify, and Leyline Binding to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six helps to ensure consistent land drops while Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command provide additional removal and flexibility. The deck relies on a mix of creativity, efficient removal, and powerful creatures to outmaneuver and overwhelm opponents in fast-paced Modern matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Persist onto the battlefield from the library or hand. This combo-focused deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption, as well as Wrenn and Six for recurring value. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate. The inclusion of Dwarven Mine and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds another layer of creativity and strategy to the deck.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively while utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cheat out powerful spells without having to pay their mana cost. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast tempo plays and efficient removal, taking advantage of cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to generate advantage and pressure the opponent. The deck utilizes a mix of traditional aggro elements with cascading spells to create a unique and powerful strategy that can catch opponents off guard and quickly close out games.

The main concept of this deck is to apply relentless pressure on the opponent by utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also incorporates powerful graveyard interactions with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Additionally, the deck aims to control the board with cards like Blood Moon and Kolaghan's Command, while maintaining card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer and Castle Locthwain. Overall, the deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay with a mix of disruption and card advantage.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing creatures with powerful abilities such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Lightning Skelemental, combined with cards like Village Rites and Unearth for card advantage, the deck can maintain a constant pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Thunderkin Awakener helps to recur creatures from the graveyard, while cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide flexibility in dealing with threats. Overall, the deck seeks to close out games quickly by attacking relentlessly and disrupting the opponent's plans.

This deck focuses on using Scapeshift to combo with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Mountains to deal a large amount of direct damage to your opponent. The deck also utilizes control elements like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Time Raveler to stall the game and protect the combo. Bring to Light acts as a versatile search tool for key cards, while cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide ramp and additional value. Leyline Binding helps protect against disruptive strategies, allowing the deck to reach its win condition efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp into Primeval Titan and other powerful threats. The key strategy involves efficiently bouncing lands with bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf to generate extra mana and aggressively search for combo pieces. The use of Urza's Saga adds additional versatility and explosiveness to the deck, allowing for powerful land tutoring options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast mana production, big threats, and efficient land manipulation to establish a dominant board presence.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity, Transmogrify, and Wrenn and Six to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. By utilizing Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to control the board while assembling its combo pieces for a game-winning play. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption and protection while Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending help to deal with threats. The land base is designed to support the combo pieces and provide consistent mana sources for the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing artifacts, utilizing cards like Frogmite, Memnite, Ornithopter, and Thoughtcast to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cranial Plating and Shadowspear are used to enhance the power of these creatures, while cards like Aether Spellbomb and Relic of Progenitus provide utility and disruption. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and various artifact lands like Darksteel Citadel and Mistvault Bridge allow for explosive plays and synergies. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of artifact creatures and win through fast, efficient attacks.
